metadata.AWS_DYNAMODB_TABLE.ThrottledRequestsHigh: timeseries value=sum(cloud.aws.dynamodb.ThrottledRequests.By.TableName), interval: 1m, by:{dt.smartscape_source.id, aws.region, aws.account.id, TableName, dt.security_context, dt.cost.costcenter} | join [smartscapeNodes \"AWS*\"| fields id, aws.resource.name], kind:leftOuter, on: left[dt.smartscape_source.id] == right[id], fields: {aws.resource.name}
metadata.AZURE_MICROSOFT_SERVICEBUS_NAMESPACES.Se: Monitors Azure Service Bus server errors to detect potential backend issues impacting message delivery and processing.
metadata.AWS_EC2_VPCENDPOINT.PacketsDroppedHigh.a: timeseries value=sum(cloud.aws.privatelinkendpoints.PacketsDropped.By.Endpoint_Type.Service_Name.VPC_Endpoint_Id.VPC_Id),interval: 1m, by:{dt.smartscape_source.id, aws.region, aws.account.id, VPC_Id,Service_Name, dt.security_context, dt.cost.costcenter} | join [smartscapeNodes \"AWS*\"| fields id, aws.resource.name], kind:leftOuter, on: left[dt.smartscape_source.id] == right[id], fields: {aws.resource.name}
metadata.AZURE_MICROSOFT_NETWORK_VIRTUALNETWORKGA: Azure ExpressRoute Gateway CPU Utilization High
metadata.AWS_ECS_CLUSTER.CpuReservationHigh.warni: timeseries value=avg(cloud.aws.ecs.CPUReservation.By.ClusterName), interval: 1m, by:{dt.smartscape_source.id, aws.region, aws.account.id, ClusterName, dt.security_context, dt.cost.costcenter} | join [smartscapeNodes \"AWS*\"| fields id, aws.resource.name], kind:leftOuter, on: left[dt.smartscape_source.id] == right[id], fields: {aws.resource.name}
metadata.AWS_ECS_CLUSTER.CpuUtilizationHigh.alert: Amazon ECS Service CPU Utilization High
metadata.AZURE_MICROSOFT_CONTAINERSERVICE_MANAGED: {azure.resource.name} kube-apiserver memory usage has exceeded acceptable threshold. Investigate memory usage patterns, caches, or controller behavior.
metadata.AZURE_MICROSOFT_NETWORK_VIRTUALNETWORKGA: {azure.resource.name} tunnel average bandwidth is higher than expected. Investigate traffic sources, tunnel utilization and connected circuits to avoid congestion or packet loss.
metadata.AWS_EC2_TRANSITGATEWAY.TransitGatewayPac: AWS Transit Gateway Packet Drop Rate High
metadata.AZURE_MICROSOFT_CACHE_REDIS.ServerLoadHi: timeseries ServerLoadPercent = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_cache.redis.serverLoad), interval:1m, by:{azure.location, azure.resource.group, azure.subscription, dt.smartscape.azure_microsoft_cache_redis, azure.resource.name, dt.smartscape_source.id}
metadata.AWS_EKS_CLUSTER.ApiServer5xxErrorRateHig: timeseries {apiserverRequest5xx=sum(cloud.aws.eks.apiserver_request_total_5XX.By.ClusterName), apiserverRequestTotal=sum(cloud.aws.eks.apiserver_request_total.By.ClusterName)}, interval: 1m, by:{dt.smartscape_source.id, aws.region, ClusterName, aws.account.id, dt.security_context, dt.cost.costcenter} | fieldsAdd value = apiserverRequest5xx[] / apiserverRequestTotal[] * 100 | fieldsRemove apiserverRequest5xx,apiserverRequestTotal | join [smartscapeNodes \"AWS*\"| fields id, aws.resource.name], kind:leftOuter, on: left[dt.smartscape_source.id] == right[id], fields: {aws.resource.name}
timeseries QueueMessageCount = avg(cloud.azure.microsoft_storage.storageaccounts.queueservices.QueueMessageCount), interval:1h, by:{azure.location, azure.resource.group, azure.subscription, dt.smartscape.azure_microsoft_storage_storageaccounts, azure.resource.name, dt.smartscape_source.id}
metadata.AZURE_MICROSOFT_CACHE_REDIS.ErrorCountHi: Azure Cache for Redis Error Count High
metadata.AZURE_MICROSOFT_NETWORK_APPLICATIONGATEW: timeseries {FailedRequestsCount = sum(cloud.azure.microsoft_network.applicationgateways.FailedRequests), TotalRequests = sum(cloud.azure.microsoft_network.applicationgateways.TotalRequests)}, interval:1m, by:{azure.location, azure.resource.group, azure.subscription, dt.smartscape.azure_microsoft_network_applicationgateways, azure.resource.name, dt.smartscape_source.id} | fieldsAdd value = FailedRequestsCount[] / TotalRequests[] * 100 | fieldsRemove FailedRequestsCount, TotalRequests
metadata.AZURE_MICROSOFT_CONTAINERSERVICE_MANAGED: Monitors Azure Kubernetes Service API server CPU usage to detect potential CPU saturation.
metadata.AZURE_MICROSOFT_NETWORK_VIRTUALNETWORKGA: {azure.resource.name} ExpressRoute Gateway shows elevated active flow counts. Investigate gateway throughput, connected circuits and routing to prevent degraded network performance.
metadata.AZURE_MICROSOFT_NETWORK_EXPRESSROUTECIRC: Monitors Azure ExpressRoute circuits to detect when BGP availability falls below acceptable threshold, indicating potential BGP session instability or connectivity issues.
metadata.AZURE_MICROSOFT_NETWORK_LOADBALANCERS.VI: Monitors Azure Load Balancer public VIP availability to detect endpoint outage.
metadata.AZURE_MICROSOFT_CONTAINERSERVICE_MANAGED: Azure Kubernetes Service API Server CPU Usage High
metadata.AZURE_MICROSOFT_NETWORK_APPLICATIONGATEW: Monitors Azure Application Gateway unhealthy backend host count to detect availability degradation.
metadata.AZURE_MICROSOFT_NETWORK_VIRTUALNETWORKGA: Detects significant increases in active flows on Azure ExpressRoute Gateways that may indicate elevated load or potential capacity issues.
metadata.AZURE_MICROSOFT_APIMANAGEMENT_SERVICE.Ca: {azure.resource.name} service capacity has exceeded the acceptable threshold. High capacity usage may lead to resource contention or degraded performance in the API Management service.

metadata.AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION.ErrorRate.alert.read: {FunctionName} is experiencing a high error rate, potentially caused by code exceptions, timeout issues, or misconfigurations; investigate function logs, error messages, and input data.
